title: My AI rockets crashed for 5 generations. Gen 13: 57 landed
caption:
AI learns lander, part 2.

My AI rockets crashed every time for 5 generations. Gen 6: the first one landed. Gen 7: 8. Gen 8: 37. Gen 13: 57. Each rocket is a small neural network that fires its thrusters; the best landers get copied with mutations.

title: My AIs cracked a 13 character password in 12 generations
caption:
AI learns password, part 3.

My AIs started with 3 of 13 characters right. Gen 4: 8. Gen 8: 11. Gen 10: 12. Gen 12: 2 of them cracked all 13. Two generations later, 45 knew it. This is a genetic algorithm: the closest guesses get copied with random mutations. It only works because the sim scores each guess.

title: The average AI creature walked 1.0. 40 generations later, 1756
caption:
